subject: Using Rstan to deconvolve and decompose a time series failing

messages.author: 4adbe8a45c90bde2
messages.subject: Using Rstan to deconvolve and decompose a time series failing
parts:
Hi all!

I'm trying to make a deconvolution and a decomposition algorithm with Rstan, but it fails.

Rstan gives 603 error messages. One of the most frequent are: " Error evaluating the log probability at the initial value."  and last ones are: Initialization between (-2, 2) failed after 100 attempts. "                                                                            
[602] " Try specifying initial values, reducing ranges of constrained values, or reparameterizing the model."                                 
[603] "Error in sampler$call_sampler(args_list[[i]]) : 


What could be done beside specifying initial values? 

Stig
